title: Count of Matches in Tournament
summary: Given an integer n representing the number of teams in a tournament, calculate the total number of matches played.
statement: Given an integer n representing the number of teams in a tournament, calculate the total number of matches played. If n is even, n / 2 matches are played; if n is odd, (n - 1) / 2 matches are played, and one team advances unpaired. Continue this process until one team remains, and the total matches are returned.
constraints: 1–200 teams; each match eliminates exactly one team.
Rounds continue until one champion remains. Return total matches.
hints: Every match removes exactly one team from championship contention.
Count eliminations instead of simulating odd and even rounds.
To reduce n teams to one survivor, return n-1.
There are n-1 eliminated teams and each match eliminates exactly one, so the match count is fixed regardless of byes.
editorial: There are n-1 eliminated teams and each match eliminates exactly one, so the match count is fixed regardless of byes.

tests.explanation: Eliminating six teams to leave one champion requires six matches.
Thirteen eliminations occur across all rounds.
